{{Quote|Yes. I feel like the mythological seer Daranas, from Alderaan&mdash;I can see the future, but no one will believe my warnings.|Barriss Offee|<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>}}
'''Daranas''' was a [[Seer (profession)|seer]] who, according to [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] mythology, had intense visions of the [[Time/Legends|future]]. However, the people whom Daranas told about these visions refused to believe them.<ref name="MedStar II" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] compared her situation at the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] to the problem Daranas encountered. Like the seer, Offee knew that an [[Battle of Drongar|attack]] would happen, although no one believed her.<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daranas was mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', the second novel of the [[MedStar Duology]]. Published in [[2004]], ''Jedi Healer'' was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
